steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each activity is placed by its deal reference and its date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Activity with no deal reference
findings.fix: Link the activity to its deal

findings.title: Owner with no logged activity today

outcome.notChecked: Activity not logged; the content of calls.

pros: Checks an activity with no deal reference, an activity dated in the future, and an owner with no logged activity in the day.
cons: Not checked: Activity not logged; the content of calls.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-activity-log skill on the records for this review.
